name: Salvinorin B methoxymethyl ether
summary: Salvinorin B methoxymethyl ether is a psychedelic substance belonging to the Salvinorin chemical class.

pharmacology.text: MOM-salB and has increased affinity and potency at the κ-opioid receptor. Salvinorin B methoxymethyl ether has a Ki of 0.60 nM at the κ-opioid receptor, and is around five times more potent than salvinorin A in animal studies, although it is still only half as potent as its ethoxymethyl ether homologue, salvinorin B ethoxymethyl ether (EOM-salB; "symmetry").

uses.text: Salvinorin B methoxymethyl ether (MOM-salB) is a semisynthetic analogue of the natural product salvinorin A which is derived from salvinorin B and used in scientific research.

sideEffects.en: Effects come on fast and can be overwhelming, with loss of touch with surroundings, falls and injuries, confusion, fear and sometimes lasting distress. Driving or being near hazards while affected is dangerous.
sideEffects.zh: 效果來得很快，可能強烈到難以承受，包括與周遭環境失去聯繫、跌倒受傷、意識混亂、恐懼，有時還有持續的不適感。在藥效期間開車或靠近危險物是危險的。
sideEffects.zhHans: 效果来得很快，可能强烈到难以承受，包括与周遭环境失去联系、跌倒受伤、意识混乱、恐惧，有时还有持续的不适感。在药效期间开车或靠近危险物是危险的。

fact.en: It is the same idea as the ethoxymethyl ether but one carbon shorter, and it binds the kappa-opioid receptor more tightly than salvinorin A itself.
fact.zh: 它和乙氧基甲基醚的設計相同，只是少一個碳，而它與 κ 鴉片受體的結合比沙維諾林 A 本身更緊密。
fact.zhHans: 它和乙氧基甲基醚的设计相同，只是少一个碳，而它与 κ 鸦片受体的结合比沙维诺林 A 本身更紧密。
